in_marathi.name: Maarisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Death
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maarisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Maarisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the goddess of death, Yamuna. In Hindu mythology, Yamuna is the goddess of death who is believed to escort the souls of the deceased to the afterlife. The name Maarisha is a beautiful and evocative reminder of the cycle of life and death.
